propositions: usage-log rows record four token fields but omit model, provider, and timestamp, and the budget shedder relies on hard-coded price guesses.
usage_log.record is extended to accept op, model, and provider and to write a UTC timestamp, with the runner call site passing the ran model and inferred provider.
summarize maps stored JSONL row token fields one-to-one into a genai-prices usage input via a pure dict-to-kwargs adapter and calls calc_price per row.
summarize groups by op and reports per-op estimated cost plus a per-model rollup, summing multi-model ops row by row.
pricing is attempted only when genai_prices imports; LookupError or any exception marks the row unpriced (WARNING logged for the latter) and pricing never breaks summarize.
when genai-prices is absent summarize still prints token totals with the cost column reading unavailable, and old-format rows without the new fields still summarize.
